summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of the Trade Me -> Dice automation console. Created pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, 20 tests) covering /api/health, /api/start validation (empty, whitespace, missing field, 409 concurrency), /api/status (404 + full completed snapshot), /api/close, plus deep assertions on extracted listing fields, KM/engine formatting (not swapped, commas preserved), ratings, photo URL conversion/download/reachability and description length. All 20 passed. Playwright UI run on the live sample Trade Me listing completed end-to-end in ~12s: log console streamed, status pill reached 'Completed', all 14 vehicle fields populated, 4/4 ratings populated, 5/5 gallery photos rendered without broken images, 2118-char description shown, Dice step skipped gracefully with the expected log line. Mobile (390px) layout has no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: listing.year returns '2021' while listing.title is '2022 Jaguar F-PACE ...' — the 'Year <yyyy>' regex matches a registration/other year in body text before the title fallback runs. Data-accuracy nit; original logic was intentionally preserved, so confirm expected behaviour.
In-memory _jobs dict grows unbounded (no eviction/TTL); long-lived process will retain every job snapshot and log list.
close_event only unblocks the Dice review wait; there is no way to abort a job stuck in the Trade Me/photo phase, so the single-job lock stays held until Playwright timeouts elapse.

issues: When Dice credentials are absent the 'Dice Fill' step stays grey/idle with no 'Skipped' state, which reads like an incomplete run even though the job reports Completed.

'Price' and 'Doors' rows are always rendered but always show '—' for this listing (Listing.price is hardcoded None in trade_me.py); consider hiding empty rows or removing the redundant 'Price' vs 'Asking Price' pair.

action_items: Confirm/fix the 'year' extraction precedence (title-derived model year vs body-text year).
Optional: mark the Dice step as 'Skipped' in the stepper when dice_configured is false.
Optional: hide always-empty vehicle-data rows (Price, Doors) or add job eviction for the in-memory store.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _active_job_id is cleared in _run's finally block, but a thread killed abruptly (process restart) would leave a stale active job; consider deriving 'active' purely from job.done.
runner.py: the exception handler emits status=error/done but never surfaces a traceback to logs (only str(e)), making live Trade Me DOM changes hard to diagnose.

photos.py: download_trade_me_photos wipes /app/temp_photos before downloading — if two jobs ever run concurrently (guard is app-level only) files from the other job are deleted; scope the temp dir per job_id.
seed_data_creation: None. Live Trade Me sample listing 6051385299 used for extraction; downloaded photos land in /app/temp_photos.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not exist. Not required — app has no auth and Dice credentials are intentionally unset (dice_configured=false verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. Each full job takes ~12-15s against the live listing; only one job may run at a time (2nd concurrent start => 409), so keep job tests sequential (module-scoped completed_job fixture handles this). Dice login path is out of scope (no creds). Verified values for the sample listing: kilometer '39,000 km', engine_cc '2,996 cc', ask_price '$74,990', ratings 1.5/5/1.5/5, 5 photos on /photoserver/full/, description 2118 chars.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only data discrepancy (year 2021 vs title 2022) stems from trade_me.py's find_regex(r'Year\s+((?:19|20)\d{2})') matching a body-text 'Year' label before the title-based fallback executes.
